papers.headline: Simulations of the Evolving Ozone Layer: Implications for the Early Earth, Exoplanets, and the Search For Life
papers.summary: Over 4 billion years, Earth's atmosphere has been transformed from a composition devoid of molecular oxygen (O₂) to one where O₂ is now 21% of our modern atmosphere by volume.
papers.title: Simulations of the Evolving Ozone Layer: Implications for the Early Earth, Exoplanets, and the Search For Life

papers.headline: Seeing Double: The Theory Defying Twin Flares of TDE 2022dbl
papers.summary: Partial tidal disruption events, in which a star survives a close passage by a supermassive black hole and may be disrupted again on a subsequent encounter, provide a unique probe of supermassive black hole properties and accretion physics.
papers.title: Seeing Double: The Theory Defying Twin Flares of TDE 2022dbl

papers.headline: Differential Luminosity Response of Balmer-Line Profiles in Galactic B/A Luminous Stars
papers.summary: We investigate the differential luminosity response of the optical Balmer series from H8 to H-alpha in Galactic B5-A5 luminous stars using homogeneous measurements of central depth, FWHM, and equivalent width at a resolving power of approximately 12,000.
papers.title: Differential Luminosity Response of Balmer-Line Profiles in Galactic B/A Luminous Stars
